SELECT  
	grouping=1,
	DateString = convert(varchar(100), dbo.saleledger.Date, 103),
	Customer = Accounts.Name,
	InvNo = dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode,
	ChitNo = dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	Description = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	Ward = (SELECT W.Name FROM Ward W WHERE W.WardCode = dbo.saleledger.WardCode),
	Date = dbo.saleledger.Date,
	itemname = item.name,
	packing = dbo.item.packingdesc,
	manufacurer = (dbo.manufacturer.name),
	looseqty = Sum (dbo.saledetail.looseqty),
	price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
	utn = max(dbo.saledetail.saleutn)
FROM 	 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Accounts,
	dbo.Manufacturer 
WHERE  
	:as_doctype = 'originaldate' AND
	dbo.saleledger.originaldate >= :ad_StartDate AND
	dbo.saleledger.originaldate <= :ad_EndDate  AND 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (SELECT CODE FROM DBO.UDF_STRINGTOTABL(:as_custcode,',') ) AND
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode AND
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
	dbo.Item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode
Group by 
	dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode,
	Accounts.Name,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.WardCode,
	dbo.saleledger.Date,
	dbo.saledetail.icode,
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.item.packingdesc,
	dbo.saledetail.saleprice,
	dbo.manufacturer.name
UNION ALL
